title: Towards Personalized Evaluation of Large Language Models with An Anonymous Crowd-Sourcing Platform

bias_targets.methodology: Using a double-blind, anonymous crowdsourcing mechanism to hide model identities during A/B comparative testing, thereby preventing user prejudice or brand preference from influencing the evaluation of the language models.

Implementing a decentralized evaluation module that allows users to submit custom, open-domain questions to mitigate biased performance results caused by benchmark dataset leakage into the models' training corpora.
